description: This file defines the TemplateVariable class within Twig that extends TempNameExpression, providing mechanisms to retrieve variable names and generate compilation code for template variables.

classes.name: TemplateVariable
classes.description: A class representing a template variable in Twig, extending TempNameExpression, responsible for managing variable names and compiling their representation in PHP code.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the variable name, generating a new one if it hasn't been set, using the compiler to generate a variable name.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for rendering the variable in the template, distinguishing between the special '_self' variable and others.
